description.value:
Trakata exploits a lightweapon's power switch as readily as its blade, toggling the weapon on and off mid-fight to bewilder and mislead an opponent. Practitioners turn every exchange into a piece of theater, using flourish and misdirection to make their next strike impossible to predict.

Deception is the true weapon here: a Trakata duelist wins as much through confusion and false openings as through the blade itself, leaving enemies unsure whether the next flash of light is a feint or a killing blow.
